episodes.synopsis: When bullies threaten Kiyoshiro’s dream by demanding half his paycheck, a delinquent with a heart of gold steps in to save the day!
episodes.title: Kiyoshiro Okamoto

episodes.synopsis: Michiru despairs when a gang steals a memento of her late brother. Kiyoshiro vows to get it back, but Hareluya won’t let him wander into the lion’s den alone.
episodes.title: Michiru Yamana

episodes.synopsis: Makoto cut ties to his old gang so he could pursue his passion, but they’re not letting him off the hook that easily.
episodes.title: Makoto Ichijo

episodes.synopsis: An unfinished work of art inspired Kiyohiro’s dream. What’s the connection between the painting and an old man who took Hareluya’s lunch money?
episodes.title: Grandpa Bob

episodes.synopsis: The Unfinished Landscape is now in the hands of an unscrupulous art dealer. Good thing Hareluya’s around to get the painting back! (But certainly not for free.)
episodes.title: Shuntaro Kitahara

episodes.synopsis: Love is in the air! Michiru wants to take Kiyoshiro to an exhibit, but Shozo’s already roped the aspiring painter into helping him win her heart.
episodes.title: Shozo Momiyama

episodes.synopsis: Makoto runs into an old friend under pressure from a local gang.
episodes.title: Megumi Aihara

episodes.synopsis: When Kiyoshiro helps Hareluya’s father, he does not know that he and his friends are about to cross paths with a puzzle cube and a young girl with a phobia of men.
episodes.title: Yuka Mochizuki

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya has a problem with the school’s baseball team but ends up impressing everyone with his throwing arm instead. Honjo witnesses this and asks Hareluya for help.
episodes.title: Yuichi Honjo

episodes.synopsis: The two baseball teams face off in a battle with a fortune on the line. But does Honjo stand a chance when his team consists of Hareluya and his friends?
episodes.title: Rui Nohara

episodes.synopsis: There’s a rumor going around that a biker is hunting the local biker gangs. Meanwhile, Hareluya gets off on the wrong foot with the new transfer student.
episodes.title: Sayaka Kano

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya and his friends are enjoying themselves at an amusement park when a girl claiming to be from another planet asks them for help!
episodes.title: Layla

episodes.synopsis: Makoto saves a young woman from her harassers only for her to tell him that violence isn’t the answer.
episodes.title: Miko Jinno

episodes.synopsis: Shozo needs someone to protect his sister and turns to Hareluya and Makoto for help.
episodes.title: Shizuka Momiya

episodes.synopsis: The attacks on Makoto’s friends lead back to Reiko and an old acquaintance.
episodes.title: Reiko Ibu

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya and his friends go on vacation only to find themselves haunted by a ghost.
episodes.title: Kaya Mizuno

episodes.synopsis: Akiko is directing an amateur film for Super Movie Contest and wants Hareluya as the starring role!
episodes.title: Akiko Jissoji

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya thinks it’s all fun and games when he pranks the arrogant transfer student. But he messed with the wrong person this time.
episodes.title: Reiji Marukido (1)

episodes.synopsis: The situation becomes grim once Michiru falls into Reiji’s clutches. Now Hareluya and the others must race against the clock to save her.
episodes.title: Reiji Marukido (2)

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya and Makoto face off against Reiji’s goons. But that means Kiyoshiro must face Reiji without their help.
episodes.title: Reiji Marukido (3)

episodes.synopsis: Michiru reunites with a friend who considers her a traitor. Worse, they’re about to get on the local surfer gang’s bad side.
episodes.title: Natsumi Nagisano

episodes.synopsis: What is Ibu doing in an underground fighting ring?
episodes.title: Taro Momoyama (1)

episodes.synopsis: Taro recruits more fighters, but why does he insist on these battles?
episodes.title: Taro Momoyama (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ibu and Naomi’s fight concludes, but the battle isn’t over yet. Baraki insists on facing Hareluya, but Makoto steps into the ring instead.
episodes.title: Taro Momoyama (3)

episodes.synopsis: Hareluya faces his most formidable opponent ever. What does Hareluya’s father know about this mysterious man?
episodes.title: Hareluya Hibino
